title: DORA Register of Information
description: Schema for the machine-readable Register of Information mandated by DORA Art.28(3) and Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2956 (ITS on the register of information). Validates structure, mandatory fields and LEI format (ISO 17442). Registration-truth of an LEI (GLEIF ACTIVE status) is NOT enforced here -- it is reported EVIDENCE-ONLY by validate-roi.py because it is not verifiable from inside the pipeline.

maintaining_entity.description: EBA template B_01.01 -- the financial entity maintaining the register.

lei.description: ISO 17442 LEI, OR the documented placeholder 'PENDING-NOT-YET-ISSUED' when the entity has no issued LEI (struktura A.1 open question). Format-blocking is applied by the validator only to issued LEIs.

ict_third_party.description: EBA templates B_01.02 / B_05.01 / B_05.02 -- one entry per ICT third-party provider.

lei.description: ISO 17442 LEI string when the provider is a legal entity that holds one, or null when lei_status is NOT_LEI_ELIGIBLE.

substitutability.description: Substitutability assessment of the provider (B_05.01). BLOCKING-required to be non-empty for Critical/High criticality.

exit_plan_ref.description: Exit plan reference / availability (B_05.01). BLOCKING-required to be non-empty for Critical/High criticality.
